guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 以相對位移、接頭剛度與止水餘量理解隧道耐震接頭。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Understand seismic tunnel joints through relative movement, joint stiffness and sealing reserve. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設沿隧道方向的適用平面波粒子速度v=0.50m/s、對應波速c=500m/s，ε=v/c=0.001；不能代入任意方向的總峰值。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設ε=0.001均勻作用於L=20m且這段變形分配給所查接頭，Δ=εL=0.020m即20mm；實際分配另算。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設剪切剛度k=50MN/m、相對位移Δ=0.010m，V=kΔ=0.50MN；此為線性範圍的力，不是接頭剪力容量。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設轉角θ=0.002rad、距旋轉軸R=4m，邊緣位移Δedge≈θR=0.008m即8mm；正負端方向相反。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設初始壓縮c0=30mm、接頭張開Δ=12mm，cres=c0−Δ=18mm；沒有材料曲線不能算接觸壓或保證不漏水。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設連接件有效長L=200mm、伸長Δ=2mm，ε=Δ/L=0.010即1%；是否彈性須另看材料與接頭構造。
factsEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For an appropriate plane wave along the tunnel, particle velocity v=0.50m/s and corresponding c=500m/s give ε=0.001. An arbitrary total peak is unsuitable.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If ε=0.001 acts uniformly over L=20m and that segment's deformation is allocated to the checked joint, Δ=0.020m, or20mm; real sharing needs analysis.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For shear stiffness k=50MN/m and Δ=0.010m, V=kΔ=0.50MN. This is linear-range demand, not joint shear capacity.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For θ=0.002rad and distance R=4m from the rotation axis, Δedge≈θR=0.008m, or8mm, with opposite signs on opposite edges.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For initial compression c0=30mm and opening Δ=12mm, cres=18mm. Without a material curve this cannot determine contact pressure or guarantee watertightness.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For effective length L=200mm and extension Δ=2mm, ε=0.010, or1%. Elasticity depends separately on material and connection details.
timeline: 2002　灣區捷運完成包含跨灣隧道的脆弱度研究
2009　美國聯邦公路管理局出版公路隧道土建手冊
2024　灣區捷運宣布跨灣隧道耐震改善完成
timelineEn: 2002 — BART completes a vulnerability study including the Transbay Tube
2009 — FHWA publishes the road-tunnel civil-elements manual
2024 — BART announces completion of the Transbay Tube seismic retrofit
codes: 美國聯邦公路管理局公路隧道土建技術手冊，2009
美國聯邦公路管理局GEC3岩土與基礎耐震手冊，2011
codesEn: FHWA Road Tunnel Civil Elements Technical Manual, 2009
FHWA GEC3 Seismic Geotechnical Features and Foundations, 2011
landmarks: 灣區捷運跨灣隧道：耐震改善
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出埋深或斷面、地質水文、支護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, ground and groundwater, support system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：隧道耐震接頭設計
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Seismic tunnel-joint design
guides.concept: 本課聚焦以相對位移、接頭剛度與止水餘量理解隧道耐震接頭。十個單元依序辨識作用機制、量化假設、驗證程序與故障徵兆，讓學徒追蹤從原始資料到工程判斷的每一環。每個算例都帶單位與限制，不把局部成功或單一比值當成完整系統合格。交接須保留基準、異常與權責工程師核准的條件。
guides.conceptEn: This course focuses on understand seismic tunnel joints through relative movement, joint stiffness and sealing reserve. Ten units connect mechanisms, numerical assumptions, verification procedures and failure symptoms so apprentices can trace each inference from evidence to judgment. Every example includes units and limitations; one successful observation or ratio does not establish system acceptance. Handover retains datums, anomalies and conditions approved by the responsible engineer.
procedure: 地下結構受地震波強迫變形，和地面建物單看慣性力的模型不同。沿隧道方向的簡化平面波可用粒子速度與對應波速估應變，但必須指定方向及波型。假設沿隧道方向的適用平面波粒子速度v=0.50m/s、對應波速c=500m/s，ε=v/c=0.001；不能代入任意方向的總峰值。若將剪波速度搭配無關方向的粒子速度，應變需求可被誤估；硬軟地層交界又可集中相對位移，平均波傳模型可能漏掉真正控制的接頭。
軸向地盤應變在一段長度上累積成位移，但並非全部都集中在單一接頭。襯砌軸向剛度、地盤摩擦及接頭分布共同決定分配，簡式只是指定分攤情境。假設ε=0.001均勻作用於L=20m且這段變形分配給所查接頭，Δ=εL=0.020m即20mm；實際分配另算。若把全長地盤位移同時分配到每一接頭，會重複計算需求；若反過來平均分攤而忽略一處特別柔軟，則可能低估該處張開與止水破壞。
接頭剪切剛度決定位移引起的力，柔性接頭能減少某些力卻可能增加位移與密封需求。線性彈簧只代表特定範圍，間隙、摩擦滑移及損傷會改變關係。假設剪切剛度k=50MN/m、相對位移Δ=0.010m，V=kΔ=0.50MN；此為線性範圍的力，不是接頭剪力容量。若模型忽略接觸閉合後剛度突然升高，峰值力可能被低估；相反，滑移後殘餘變形也可能超出止水能力，即使計算內力看似下降。
接頭轉角會使截面邊緣相對張開，中心位移很小也可能在外緣造成止水需求。小角近似適用於指定旋轉軸，實際多軸運動需組合而不能只採單一截面。假設轉角θ=0.002rad、距旋轉軸R=4m，邊緣位移Δedge≈θR=0.008m即8mm；正負端方向相反。單點量測若靠近旋轉中心，會低估邊緣開口；假設整條止水帶承受相同壓縮會漏掉一側失去接觸、另一側過度壓縮的同時發生。
止水剩餘壓縮量是幾何量，水密性還取決於材料曲線、老化、表面及水壓。幾何仍有接觸不等於接觸壓力足夠，必須用試驗建立容許的運動範圍。假設初始壓縮c0=30mm、接頭張開Δ=12mm，cres=c0−Δ=18mm；沒有材料曲線不能算接觸壓或保證不漏水。止水老化硬化或局部折皺會讓相同壓縮量產生不同接觸狀態；只保留名義幾何餘量可能忽略細小通道，在持續外水壓下逐步發展滲漏。
接頭連接件的變形集中於有效自由長度，不能把位移除以整支外觀長度稀釋應變。局部塑性、螺紋及錨定區可能先控制，線性應變估算不能直接當疲勞壽命。假設連接件有效長L=200mm、伸長Δ=2mm，ε=Δ/L=0.010即1%；是否彈性須另看材料與接頭構造。把錨固在混凝土中的長度也當可均勻伸長，會低估局部應變；反覆運動可在螺紋根部或接合處累積損傷，即使整體位移仍在名義行程內。
永久斷層錯動和振動造成的往復變形不是同一荷載情境，需分別評估。將錯距分攤到變形帶只能提供平均幾何需求，實際局部剪切可能更集中。假設相對錯距Δ=0.50m、分布寬L=20m，平均γ=Δ/L=0.025即2.5%；並非斷層位移的預測公式。若實際錯動集中於狹窄面，原本分散到長距離的柔性安排可能無效；單一接頭的容量再大也未必容納複合剪切與旋轉，鄰近襯砌可能先受損。
兩個接頭串聯承受相同力而分攤位移，柔度相加不是剛度直接相加。此模型需要相同作用方向且無旁路，土體及其他連接若提供平行路徑必須另建網路。假設k1=100MN/m、k2=50MN/m串聯，keq=(1/k1+1/k2)⁻¹=33.3MN/m；不適用直接並聯相加。串並聯判錯會大幅改變需求分配；較軟接頭可能吃掉大部分位移而先超限，若只用平均剛度，會掩蓋局部止水與連接件的控制情境。
地震後接頭需同時面對殘餘位移與可能改變的水壓，密封檢核不能只在無水狀態做。靜水壓增量簡單，但裂縫連通、排水損壞及水頭來源須由現場資料確認。假設外側水頭增加Δh=8m，Δu=γwΔh=9.81×8=78.48kPa，約78.5kPa；此為增加值而非總設計水壓。若只驗接頭沒有斷裂而忽略外水恢復，密封可能在稍後水頭升高才失效；排水系統同時受損時，漏水後果可能比單一構件損傷更嚴重。
接頭容量須對應具體運動方向、水壓、老化及循環條件，不能把單軸試驗行程當所有組合的許可值。名義餘量幫助整理，最終仍要查多軸包絡與施工公差。假設同一方向相同試驗條件的容量40mm、需求25mm，餘量40−25=15mm；未包含旋轉、剪切及公差互制。若以最大試驗行程減平均需求，可能忽略最不利接頭與多軸組合；施工初始偏差已消耗部分容量時，表面正餘量不能證明震後仍可維持水密與通行。
procedureEn: Seismic waves impose ground deformation on tunnels, unlike a model considering only building inertia. A simplified wave along the tunnel relates particle velocity to the corresponding wave speed, requiring an explicit direction and wave type. For an appropriate plane wave along the tunnel, particle velocity v=0.50m/s and corresponding c=500m/s give ε=0.001. An arbitrary total peak is unsuitable. Combining shear-wave speed with unrelated particle motion misestimates strain. Stiff-soft transitions can also concentrate displacement, so a mean wave model may miss the joint controlling actual performance.

Axial ground strain accumulates over length but does not necessarily concentrate at one joint. Lining stiffness, ground friction and joint distribution govern sharing; the simple relation represents a specified allocation scenario. If ε=0.001 acts uniformly over L=20m and that segment's deformation is allocated to the checked joint, Δ=0.020m, or20mm; real sharing needs analysis. Allocating total tunnel displacement to every joint double counts demand. Uniform sharing can instead understate opening at an unusually flexible joint and miss loss of water sealing.

Joint shear stiffness converts movement to force. Flexibility may reduce force while increasing displacement and sealing demand; a linear spring applies only within a range, before gaps, frictional slip or damage change behaviour. For shear stiffness k=50MN/m and Δ=0.010m, V=kΔ=0.50MN. This is linear-range demand, not joint shear capacity. Ignoring sudden stiffness increase after contact can understate peak force. Conversely, residual slip may exceed sealing capacity even when the calculated force falls, so one favourable response measure is insufficient.

Joint rotation opens edges even when centre movement is small. A small-angle approximation needs a defined axis; multi-axis motion requires combination rather than one section's result. For θ=0.002rad and distance R=4m from the rotation axis, Δedge≈θR=0.008m, or8mm, with opposite signs on opposite edges. A sensor near the rotation centre can miss edge opening. Uniform seal compression assumptions conceal simultaneous contact loss on one side and excessive compression on the other.

Remaining seal compression is geometric. Watertightness also depends on material response, ageing, contact surfaces and water pressure. Continued geometric contact does not establish enough contact pressure; testing defines the admissible motion range. For initial compression c0=30mm and opening Δ=12mm, cres=18mm. Without a material curve this cannot determine contact pressure or guarantee watertightness. Ageing or wrinkles can change contact at the same nominal compression. A geometric reserve alone misses small flow paths that can develop into leakage under sustained external pressure.

Connector extension concentrates over the effective free length, not necessarily its full visible length. Plasticity, threads and anchorage may govern; a simple strain estimate is not a fatigue-life calculation. For effective length L=200mm and extension Δ=2mm, ε=0.010, or1%. Elasticity depends separately on material and connection details. Counting embedded length as uniformly extensible understates local strain. Repeated movement can damage thread roots or connections while overall displacement remains within the nominal stroke.

Permanent fault offset differs from oscillatory shaking and requires a separate scenario. Spreading offset over a deformation band provides only average geometric demand; localized shear may be more concentrated. For assumed offset Δ=0.50m distributed across L=20m, mean γ=0.025, or2.5%. This is not a formula predicting fault displacement. Concentrated offset can defeat flexibility distributed over a long distance. Even a large single-joint capacity may not accommodate combined shear and rotation before adjacent lining is damaged.

Two series joints carry the same force and share displacement; add compliance rather than stiffness. The model assumes one direction without bypasses, while ground or other parallel connections require a different network. For series k1=100MN/m and k2=50MN/m, keq=(1/k1+1/k2)⁻¹=33.3MN/m, unlike a parallel stiffness sum. Confusing series and parallel paths changes demand allocation substantially. The softer joint can take most displacement and fail first while an average stiffness hides controlling seal and connector conditions.

After shaking, joints face residual movement and potentially changed water pressure. Dry testing alone is insufficient; pressure increment is simple, but fracture connections, damaged drainage and head sources need field evidence. For an external head increase Δh=8m, Δu=78.48kPa, about78.5kPa. This is added pressure, not total design pressure. A joint may remain intact yet leak later as water head recovers. Concurrent drainage damage can make that leakage more consequential than the initial visible component damage suggests.

Joint capacity belongs to a specified direction, pressure, ageing and cycling condition. A uniaxial stroke is not allowable for every combination; nominal reserve organizes evidence but needs multiaxis and tolerance checks. For capacity40mm and demand25mm in the same direction and test conditions, reserve is15mm, excluding rotation, shear and tolerance interaction. Subtracting mean demand from maximum test stroke misses critical joints and combined motion. Initial installation offsets may already consume capacity, so a positive nominal reserve cannot prove post-event sealing or access.
evidence: 交接波傳軸向應變時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。核對地震輸入的方向、波型與波速剖面，將自由場應變和土結互制分析比較。對斜交波及地層變化保留專門分析，不把此式當所有地震情境的包絡值。
交接接頭相對伸長時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。將環縫與縱向接頭位置畫成變形相容圖，檢查位移和襯砌伸長的總和。比較接頭量測及模型結果，對端部、剛度變化與特殊構造另設控制點。
交接接頭剪切剛度時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。用代表性接頭試驗確認力位移曲線、循環退化與溫度條件，將軸向壓力也列入比較。設計須同時檢查力、位移及密封，不能只降低剛度求較小內力。
交接轉角邊緣張開時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。使用至少可辨識轉動的多點位移配置，將剛體平移與旋轉分開擬合。核對止水所在實際半徑及安裝偏差，再以經核准的多軸試驗包絡確認需求。
交接止水壓縮幾何餘量時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。核對密封材料批次、初始壓縮與接觸面公差，採具代表水壓和多軸位移的試驗。把老化後性能與施工偏差納入包絡，驗收由設計與品質責任人共同簽認。
evidenceEn: When handing over wave induced axial strain, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Check input direction, wave type and velocity profile, comparing free-field strain with interaction analysis. Oblique waves and stratigraphic transitions require specific treatment; the relation is not a universal seismic envelope.

When handing over joint relative extension, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Map circumferential and longitudinal joints in a compatibility diagram, checking the sum of joint movement and lining extension. Compare measured and modelled response at ends, stiffness changes and special structures.

When handing over joint shear stiffness, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Test representative force-displacement response, cyclic degradation and temperature, including axial loading. Check force, movement and sealing together rather than selecting low stiffness solely to reduce calculated force.

When handing over rotation induced edge opening, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Use multiple displacement points to distinguish rigid translation and rotation. Check the actual seal radius and installation tolerance, then compare demand with an approved multiaxis test envelope.

When handing over seal compression geometry reserve, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Verify seal batch, initial compression and contact tolerances using representative pressure and multiaxis tests. Include aged performance and installation deviation in the envelope, with design and quality leads jointly accepting evidence.
pitfalls: 若將剪波速度搭配無關方向的粒子速度，應變需求可被誤估；硬軟地層交界又可集中相對位移，平均波傳模型可能漏掉真正控制的接頭。
若模型忽略接觸閉合後剛度突然升高，峰值力可能被低估；相反，滑移後殘餘變形也可能超出止水能力，即使計算內力看似下降。
止水老化硬化或局部折皺會讓相同壓縮量產生不同接觸狀態；只保留名義幾何餘量可能忽略細小通道，在持續外水壓下逐步發展滲漏。
若實際錯動集中於狹窄面，原本分散到長距離的柔性安排可能無效；單一接頭的容量再大也未必容納複合剪切與旋轉，鄰近襯砌可能先受損。
若只驗接頭沒有斷裂而忽略外水恢復，密封可能在稍後水頭升高才失效；排水系統同時受損時，漏水後果可能比單一構件損傷更嚴重。
pitfallsEn: Combining shear-wave speed with unrelated particle motion misestimates strain. Stiff-soft transitions can also concentrate displacement, so a mean wave model may miss the joint controlling actual performance.

Ignoring sudden stiffness increase after contact can understate peak force. Conversely, residual slip may exceed sealing capacity even when the calculated force falls, so one favourable response measure is insufficient.
Ageing or wrinkles can change contact at the same nominal compression. A geometric reserve alone misses small flow paths that can develop into leakage under sustained external pressure.
Concentrated offset can defeat flexibility distributed over a long distance. Even a large single-joint capacity may not accommodate combined shear and rotation before adjacent lining is damaged.
A joint may remain intact yet leak later as water head recovers. Concurrent drainage damage can make that leakage more consequential than the initial visible component damage suggests.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 液化地盤評估與改善
related.transfer: 可遷移「波傳軸向應變」與「斷層變形帶需求」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；液化地盤評估與改善的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Wave induced axial strain" and "Fault deformation band demand" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Liquefaction assessment and mitigation must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以相對位移、接頭剛度與止水餘量理解隧道耐震接頭；液化地盤評估與改善則以區分液化觸發、永久變形與改善覆蓋的驗證需求為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on understand seismic tunnel joints through relative movement, joint stiffness and sealing reserve; Liquefaction assessment and mitigation centres on separate liquefaction triggering, permanent deformation and verified treatment coverage, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「波傳軸向應變」與「飽和土有效應力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到液化地盤評估與改善，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「改善抗力增幅」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Wave induced axial strain” and “Effective stress in saturated soil”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Liquefaction assessment and mitigation, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Treatment resistance gain", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 隧道耐震接頭設計
history.text: 本課以公開工程研究與機構文件建立以相對位移、接頭剛度與止水餘量理解隧道耐震接頭的背景。灣區捷運完成包含跨灣隧道的脆弱度研究（2002）。美國聯邦公路管理局出版公路隧道土建手冊（2009）。灣區捷運宣布跨灣隧道耐震改善完成（2024）。兩個地標用來比較環境、量測與維護證據，並非宣稱本課每一教學構件都實際用於兩處。來源若只可讀摘要，適用範圍已另行註明；現場設計須重新確認規範版本與責任。本課只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: This course uses public research and institutional documents to establish context for understand seismic tunnel joints through relative movement, joint stiffness and sealing reserve. BART completes a vulnerability study including the Transbay Tube (2002). FHWA publishes the road-tunnel civil-elements manual (2009). BART announces completion of the Transbay Tube seismic retrofit (2024). The two landmarks compare environments, measurements and maintenance evidence; they do not imply that every teaching component was installed at both sites. Abstract-only access is declared in source scopes. Field design requires current applicability and responsible review. This course reconstructs public principles only.
